# @canopy/node-http

Serves Web standard fetch handlers on node:http and Express, streaming bodies and passing the peer address.

Every Canopy handler is a Web standard fetch handler; this runs one on Node.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/node-http
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { createServer } from "node:http"
import { toNodeListener } from "@canopy/node-http"

const handler = async (request: Request): Promise<Response> =>
  Response.json({ path: new URL(request.url).pathname })

createServer(toNodeListener(handler)).listen(3000)
```
